title: Ollaya Model Manager
default_inference_note: If an n8n decision request omits the model field, the proxy inserts the default model above.
storage_note: Home Assistant preserves this app-private directory across restarts and upgrades. It is separate from /data/options.json, which Supervisor manages.
registry_model_note: Or enter a registered Ollaya model name (not an arbitrary Hugging Face URL):
management_disabled: Model management is disabled. Enable the Model management option in Home Assistant configuration, save and restart to install or remove models.
download_diagnostics: For REGISTRY_ERROR, check DNS and outbound HTTPS access to the Ollaya registry and the model host on Hugging Face. For DIGEST_MISMATCH, retry the verified download. Inference remains local.
private_port: Internal Home Assistant app-network port: 11435. No host port is published by default.
auth_required: Inference calls require Authorization: Bearer <API key>.
api_readonly_note: The client API never exposes model installation or deletion. Inference runs locally; model installation contacts external registries.
health_note: For n8n health checks, send an authenticated GET to /health (200 = ready, 503 = unavailable).
memory_metrics_note: In-memory counters reset on restart. Request bodies, email contents and API keys are never stored as metrics.
management_required: Model management is disabled in Home Assistant configuration
model_active_remove: Select another default model before removing the current one
another_pull: Another model download is already running
model_not_installed: Install the model before selecting it
